REFERENCE PRIORITY: <Picture 1> and <Picture 2> are the ONLY visual references, and both depict THE SAME PERSON.
<Picture 1> = STORYBOARD + MASTER ENVIRONMENT + NINE DRESSING-STAGE POSES: it defines the nine sequential getting-dressed stages, the boudoir room, the action at each stage, and stage poses.
<Picture 2> = CHARACTER IDENTITY + 360-DEGREE COSTUME STRUCTURE REFERENCE: its four panels (face close-up, full front, full side, full back) define the woman's face, hairstyle, hair ornaments, jewelry, and the front/side/back structure of every garment and the shoes.
<Picture 2> is NOT a storyboard. Do NOT reproduce its turnaround-sheet layout, its side-by-side panel arrangement, its plain white studio background, or its neutral standing A-pose. The boudoir environment comes ONLY from <Picture 1>; NEVER use <Picture 2>'s white studio backdrop. The four figures in <Picture 2> are ONE person from four viewing angles — do NOT treat them as four different people and do NOT merge them into multiple characters.

<Subject 1> is the adult East Asian woman shown in both <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, with the face, features, and refined natural makeup defined authoritatively by the <Picture 2> close-up: center-parted long dark hair styled in a Song-dynasty half-up crown, with white ginkgo-leaf-shaped hair ornaments at BOTH temples, and extremely long straight hair flowing down her back to hip level (as seen in the <Picture 2> side and back views). Slender body proportions, calm elegant demeanor. A double red-cord necklace with a central white jade lock pendant and two small gold beads is already worn at the start. She is the ONLY person in the entire video.
<Subject 2> is the complete pale blue-white Song-style costume system, with its 360-degree structure defined by <Picture 2> front/side/back views and its dressing order defined by <Picture 1>: (a) white camisole and white shorts undergarment set; (b) pale blue embroidered camisole top with small white flower appliques at both shoulder points; (c) layered long flowing gradient pale-blue-white skirt with subtle embroidery near the hem; (d) semi-transparent pale blue outer layer made of cold-shoulder detached wide streamer-sleeves draping from the upper arms, extremely long and wide, with tiny bead weights at the sleeve-panel hems; (e) pale blue waist sash fastened with a white flower clasp, a red cord tassel with white jade drops hanging at front; (f) pale blue low-heel pumps with a small toe ornament; (g) pearl drop earrings. <Subject 3> is the Song-dynasty boudoir interior from <Picture 1> ONLY, with a FIXED physical layout: a wooden clothes rack at stage-right, a wooden clothing chest beside it, open dressing space in the room center, a low daybed at left-back, and an antique wooden vanity table with a round bronze mirror at right-back; lattice windows with sheer curtains, a folding screen, flower branches in vases, and scrolls. Soft daylight enters from the lattice windows at ONE fixed direction and never changes. Palette of rice white, light wood, blue-grey, pale cyan.
<Picture 1> is the 3x3 storyboard defining the nine sequential dressing stages, the environment, and the approved pose for each stage.
<Picture 2> is the character turnaround reference (face close-up plus front, side, back full-body views) defining identity and the all-angle costume, hair, accessory, and shoe structure; it controls appearance only, never composition or background.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is ONE SINGLE UNINTERRUPTED 15-second continuous long take — no cuts, no crossfades, no dissolves — showing <Subject 1> physically walking through <Subject 3> along a continuous path (clothes rack → room center → daybed → vanity → bronze mirror) while progressively putting on every layer of <Subject 2>, following the nine-stage storyboard in <Picture 1>, with face, hair, and the front/side/back structure of every garment locked to <Picture 2>. The camera physically tracks, arcs, follows, lowers, and pulls back in one unbroken trajectory; whenever the camera sees her side or back, the long hair, sleeve streamers, and back skirt layers must match the <Picture 2> side and back views. Each dressing action's recovery is the next action's preparation; fabric responds to body movement with delayed follow-through and natural settling.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic high-end ancient-fashion editorial film with soft natural window light, gentle shadows, real skin texture, and natural motion blur during movement. Named pattern: Single-Take Wardrobe Accumulation Follow — ONE continuous physical camera for the entire 15 seconds. The camera always maintains correct perspective, parallax, and spatial depth relative to the fixed room; it never teleports, never passes through the woman's body or furniture, and never cuts.

[Shot 1] (00:00.000–00:15.000, ONE unbroken long take, NO cuts at any point)

At 00:00.000, the camera holds a three-quarter full-body framing at approximately 2 meters from <Subject 1>, who stands barefoot beside the wooden clothes rack at stage-right wearing only the white camisole and white shorts, her hip-length dark hair falling down her back and the paired ginkgo-leaf ornaments at her temples (stage 1). Her right arm extends to grasp a pale blue embroidered camisole top hanging on the rack while her left arm hangs relaxed at her side. She lifts the camisole off the rack, raises it overhead with both hands, and slips it down over her torso in one smooth motion; her arms thread through the straps and her hands smooth the embroidered fabric, settling the small white shoulder flowers at both shoulder points (stage 2 complete by 00:01.800).

Without pausing, her right hand returns to the rack and takes the semi-transparent pale blue outer layer; both hands hold it open in front of her as she turns with a real weight-shifting step toward the room center. The camera begins a slow lateral track matching her walking pace. At the clothing chest she steps into the gradient pale-blue skirt one foot at a time with visible knee lift and weight transfer, draws it to her waist, then sweeps the sheer outer layer up and over her shoulders, settling its cold-shoulder bands over the upper arms so the long streamer-sleeves drape down on both sides; her right arm guides the right panel, then her left arm guides the left, translucent fabric cascading around her (stage 3 complete by 00:05.000). The camera continues a gentle clockwise arc of approximately 90 degrees at a steady 1.8-meter distance; as it moves toward her side, her profile, hip-length back hair, and the side drape of the skirt and sleeve streamers match the <Picture 2> side view.

Standing in the room center, she takes the pale blue waist sash, wraps it around her waist with both arms, crosses the ends at front, and fastens the white flower clasp; her hands smooth the sash flat and arrange the red cord tassel with white jade drops at center-front (stages 4–5 complete by 00:07.200). She then raises both hands to her shoulders to lift and settle the outer layer's shoulder seams, guiding the bead-weighted streamer sleeves into elegant hanging folds (stage 6 complete by 00:08.600). The arc settles into a near-frontal three-quarter angle. Every adjustment produces visible fabric response: the streamer panels and skirt sway with arm and torso movement, their bead hems tracing a slightly delayed arc, then settle.

She turns left and takes two real walking steps toward the low daybed at left-back, the skirt and sleeve streamers swaying naturally with each hip movement; the camera tracks laterally and lowers slightly as she bends her knees and lowers her body weight to sit on the daybed edge in one controlled motion. Seated, she crosses her right leg over her left with a natural knee bend, reaches both hands to her right foot, and slips on the pale blue low-heel pump; she uncrosses and recrosses to put the second pump on her left foot (stage 7 complete by 00:10.800).

She rises by pushing up through her legs with visible weight transfer, takes three steps to the vanity table at right-back, and sits on its stool; the camera follows alongside and pushes gently to a medium framing. Her hands lift to her ears and fasten the pearl drop earrings, one hand steadying the earlobe while the other secures each earring (stage 8 complete by 00:12.800). The jewelry box and flower branches on the vanity remain fixed.

She stands, turns to face the round bronze mirror, and takes one final small step into position (stage 9). The camera smoothly rises and pulls back in one continuous reverse-dolly to a full-body framing at approximately 2.5 meters, revealing the complete boudoir. She stands fully dressed in the complete <Subject 2> system — embroidered camisole with shoulder flowers, layered gradient skirt, bead-weighted streamer sleeves, sash with flower clasp and red jade tassel, low-heel pumps, red-cord jade necklace, pearl earrings, and paired ginkgo-leaf hair ornaments — hands gently clasped at front waist, gazing into the bronze mirror with calm composure, her long hair falling straight down her back exactly as in the <Picture 2> back view. The sheer layers settle; the camera holds this final full-body silhouette until 00:15.000.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous quiet boudoir room tone for the full 15 seconds. Soft silk and fabric rustling synchronized to each dressing action — garments sliding overhead, sheer panels sweeping over shoulders, the sash pulling taut, skirt and streamer fabric swaying with footsteps, a faint click of the small bead weights against one another. Barefoot footsteps on wooden floor for the first half, soft low-heel footsteps after 00:10.800. The gentle creak of the daybed and stool as she sits and rises. A faint click of each earring fastening. Distant birdsong through lattice windows.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained solo guqin score at a slow meditative tempo with sparse notes and long resonant pauses, joined softly by a dizi bamboo-flute line after 00:08.000. The music flows in one unbroken arc with no restart and no swell, matching the single continuous take. Instrumental only. No vocals, no lyrics, no percussion.

The target video uses a high-fashion editorial anime style: clean graphic linework, sculptural couture silhouettes, glossy strobe-lit skin, and an icy-cool glamour mood.
